papers.title: PaperSearchQA: Learning to Search and Reason over Scientific Papers with RLVR

training_data.name: PaperSearchQA
training_data.quote: PaperSearchQA contains 60,000 question-answer pairs generated from PubMed abstracts. Training set: 54,907 Q&A pairs. Test set: 5,000 Q&A pairs. Used GPT-4.1 to generate 3 questions per sampled abstract. The model card lists the same 54,907 / 5,000 / 59,907 counts and does not say whether the test split was held out of training.

training_method.objective_quote: The model may include one or more of the following training stages: 1. Supervised Fine-Tuning. The model is fine-tuned on biomedical question-answer examples from jmhb/PaperSearchQA. 4. Search-Agent or RLVR Training. The model may include reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards.

description.text: EpistemeAI/OpenMedResearch-Gemma-4E4N is an open biomedical research model fine-tuned from `google/gemma-4-E4B` using the `jmhb/PaperSearchQA` dataset. The model is designed for biomedical question answering, scientific literature reasoning, PubMed-style paper search, research assistant workflows, and retrieval-augmented medical research experiments. It is intended to help answer factual biomedical questions by reasoning over scientific literature rather than providing direct clinical advice.

serving.notes: config.json sets text_config.max_position_embeddings to 131072 and unsloth_version to 2026.6.7. The card says context length up to 128K tokens. The printed example uses temperature 0.2, top_p 0.9, max_new_tokens 256, and do_sample true, which differs from generation_config.json. The chat template inserts the caller's system message and does not hardcode the biomedical assistant line. Hub pipeline tag is image-text-to-text. One model.safetensors file, no adapter_config.json. Safetensors total is BF16.

discrepancies: The inventory method is sft. The card puts supervised fine-tuning, retrieval-augmented reasoning, RLVR, and optional preference tuning under one sentence: the model may include one or more of those stages. The inventory parent is unsloth/gemma-4-E4B-it, which matches the YAML, the Unsloth footer, and config.json model_name. The opening sentence and the model-type list name google/gemma-4-E4B. The dataset id matches.
